relationship: New fixed follow-up prompted by v1 failure: all original 8 arms stopped at 2000 updates before reaching the registered CPU budget. This design was chosen after viewing those outcomes; not blind/independent confirmation.

task_contract.brownian_event_sample: SpikeStream.default_spec; per-observation events; exact physical order

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.stop: after crossing 25 process-CPU seconds at end of optimizer update

budget_match_gate: For each task/seed pair both arms must stop due to >=25 CPU seconds, not max_steps; absolute training CPU difference divided by max(arm CPU seconds) <= 0.05. Any invalid pair is retained as NO_GO and must not be used as evidence of matched training cost.
negative_evidence: Retain all attempted runs including failures, errant costs, partials, and no-benefit outcomes, without cherry picking; never modify historic v1 results.
scope_limits: nonblinded exploratory follow-up rather than independent confirmation
training CPU is not GPU FLOPs or end-to-end joules
no post-hoc thresholds or exclusion of bad seed
no production, no signed persistent crash recovery or real 4-modal inputs
